newsitem.title: USA: Eskimo Pie CEO David Clark resigns.
newsitem.headline: Eskimo Pie CEO David Clark resigns.

text.p: Eskimo Pie Corp said Thursday that David Clark has resigned as president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.

The company said Arnold Dreyfuss, former director, board chairman and chief executive of Hamilton Beach/Procter-Silex Inc, has assumed the position as board chairman and interim chief executive for Eskimo Pie pending a search for Clark's replacement.
Dreyfuss was an Eskimo Pie Corp board member and director before he retired, said J.L. Cheatham, Eskimo Pie director of investor relations.
Trading for Eskimo Pie was halted at 1321 EDT at 15.

The company said "1996 has been a disappointing year for Eskimo Pie Corp, but with the excellent brand names we bring to the category and a sharp focus on our future, we are confident (the company) will remain a leader in the frozen novelty category."
